messages.content: Extract only factual arguments needed by the kernel. Identify the person and calendar year named in the question. Extract explicit statutory givens saying that an individual is a taxpayer's qualifying child or qualifying relative for a stated taxpayer year. Preserve direction exactly: X being Y's child is not evidence that Y is X's child. Do not infer qualifying status from kinship alone and do not decide whether section 152(b)(1) applies. For each channel, mark resolved only after inspecting the complete supplied facts and extracting its finite set; otherwise mark unknown. An unknown channel is not an empty array. Return nonempty verbatim witnesses from the current facts or question and list any factual uncertainty that prevents faithful extraction.
